independentDisputedReview.reviewType: Bounded independent editorial review of disputed profiles
independentDisputedReview.scope: Read the supplied profiles, attached selected works and inspection metadata for 27 people across batches 1–4; compared specific high-risk claims and work relationships with relevant source records. Fresh retrieval targeted attribution, identity, source provenance and access-label risks. Batch 5 was consulted only for shared-work merge collisions and already inspected related evidence.
independentDisputedReview.result: No new instance found of these profiles affirming the underlying extraordinary claims or treating testimony as independent corroboration within this bounded review. Four concrete integration/editorial findings are listed; one is a merge collision already detected by root.

findings.finding: The same work ID identifies three separate works: the 1998 Book V in batch 1, the 2018 Ra Contact compilation in batch 3, and Wheelock’s edition-guide webpage in batch 5. A last-write merge would corrupt titles, dates and person roles.

verification.productionBuild: Passed npm run build: 287 routes, release/discovery checks and 133 build-invoked tests (94 DPC model, 9 Buildmine model, 15 UFO/People DOM, 2 Buildmine UI, 6 DPC UI, 7 FKL).
verification.focusedGuards: Release guard explicitly permits external QuTech /lab/ source paths while still rejecting relative, same-origin and protocol-relative site Lab discovery links.
verification.fullDataset: All 251 profiles, 159 work records, person/event/source links and image provenance validated. All 251 generated profile pages checked for no-JS content, unique IDs, source links, valid local URLs and noindex. Every work has a person reference.
verification.navigation: Built-client DOM tests cover search, aliases, works, institutions, roles, featured, reset, empty state, sorting, inline open/close, focus calls, direct/refresh state, back/forward state restoration, cached fetch, failed fetch, failed image, person/event return links, preserved timeline filters and complete export. These are DOM tests, not a native-browser keyboard or layout test.
verification.preservation: All 399 event objects, 270 non-person entities, 426 existing source records, existing sourceReviews and every old /ufos/ HTML anchor preserved. One relationship collaborator typo corrected from Martin Hauer to Michael Hauer. Unrelated HTML unchanged after normalizing generated asset filenames (Buildmine and preview had asset-name-only differences).
verification.browserLimit: No supported Browser preview was available in this managed Sites environment. The Sites skill prohibits alternate local servers or browser installs here. No real-browser screenshots, touch/keyboard device run, screen-reader test, browser overflow measurements or image-network waterfall were performed.
verification.staticRenders: Production directory and a long David Grusch profile rendered and visually inspected at 390 and 1440 px, plus 320 px narrow renders, using WeasyPrint with width-query and renderer compatibility rules. These are static review images, explicitly labeled; they do not replace browser/device verification.

externalLinks.scope: HTTP GET response checks of every unique URL used by biography references and selected-work links; response status is not content inspection. Portrait source/rights retrieval is recorded in the separate portrait audit. A 404/410 here remains possible-missing until independently checked. Requests streamed and closed without downloading whole books.

verification.publication: Not merged or deployed. Owner approval is required after the concrete preview under AGENTS.md. No live publication receipt asserted.
